Both changes are committed successfully:

1. **`1b0dbf9`** – Promoted the pending clock note ("Add monotonic clock fallback.") into `CHANGELOG.md` under the `# Next` section, satisfying the release policy requirement (token `CLOCK-PROMOTE-12`).
2. **`201732c`** – Cleared the now-redundant `changes/pending/clock.md` fragment since its content was promoted.

Regarding the "initial clean-tree commit attempt": the repo tree was clean before any edits, so a commit attempted at that point would have had nothing to commit and failed/no-op. I recovered from that by first making the actual edit (promoting the note into the changelog) and then issuing the commit, which succeeded as shown above.
